column1: # ZAP baseline scan rules for .github/workflows/zap-baseline.yml (tab-separated: rule id, action, name).
# FAIL fails the scan; WARN is reported only; IGNORE is skipped. Every IGNORE says why.
# Headers GitHub Pages can't send (the site sets its CSP in a meta tag instead). Switch these to FAIL after
# moving to Cloudflare Pages, which sends public/_headers (docs/CLOUDFLARE_MOVE.md, step 6).

column3: Anti-clickjacking header (GitHub Pages can't send X-Frame-Options)
X-Content-Type-Options header missing (GitHub Pages can't send it)
Content Security Policy header not set (the CSP is in a meta tag on GitHub Pages)
CSP: no fallback for frame-ancestors (browsers ignore it in a meta tag; needs the header)
Permissions Policy header not set (GitHub Pages can't send it)
Insufficient site isolation against Spectre (COOP, CORP and COEP need headers)
Cross-domain misconfiguration (GitHub Pages allows any origin to read public static files)
Re-examine cache-control directives (GitHub Pages sets caching)
